commands.projects.explain.title: Explain the project
commands.projects.explain.hint: smith explain <project>: what the project is, how smith sees it and why
commands.projects.why.title: Show who owns the project's files
commands.projects.why.hint: smith why <root>: what produced each file of the project
commands.projects.graph.title: Show the dependencies and the dependants
commands.projects.graph.hint: smith graph --focus <project>: the dependencies and the dependants
commands.projects.derive-explain.title: Explain the derived files
commands.projects.derive-explain.hint: smith derive --explain: who owns each file and why it is in its state
commands.projects.derive-apply.title: Update the derived files
commands.projects.derive-apply.hint: smith derive: writes the files that are out of date or missing; never overwrites a file you edited
commands.projects.derive-adopt.title: Keep my edit of a derived file
commands.projects.derive-adopt.hint: smith derive --adopt: takes your edit of a keys file as the new baseline
commands.projects.derive-eject.title: Own the files I edited
commands.projects.derive-eject.hint: smith derive --eject: the files become yours and smith stops touching them
commands.projects.derive-replace.title: Replace the files I edited
commands.projects.derive-replace.hint: smith derive --replace: overwrites them with what smith derives; your edit is lost
